estate.help.advice.title: Estate & provision (advice)
estate.help.advice.body: The estate adviser gives the household an overview of its provisions (provision documents, contracts with customer numbers, digital estate without passwords, key contacts, funeral wishes, where things are kept) and records and maintains them in the emergency register. In an emergency case (death/incapacity) it guides you with care: a step-by-step checklist with legal deadlines that the database calculates to the day (registry office, insurance notification deadlines, disclaimer of inheritance, inheritance tax, ...), 'one next task after another', a daily deadline reminder and a look into the register. The printable EMERGENCY BINDER (the whole register as one forwardable document) and the system profile (where the offline copy of the backup key is kept) give the bereaved everything they need — even when the system is off; the command /notfall is the fixed entry point that does not depend on the AI. It does not replace legal advice.
